unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.body: Restart Hat. If it comes back, open the logs and send them our way.

network-offline.title: You're offline
network-offline.body: No network. The queue holds messages until you're back.

firebase-auth-popup-blocked.title: Popup blocked
firebase-auth-popup-blocked.body: Google sign-in opened and closed too fast. Allow popups for Hat and retry.

firebase-auth-network-request-failed.title: No network for sign-in
firebase-auth-network-request-failed.body: Google didn't respond. Check your connection and come back.

firebase-auth-account-exists-with-differ.title: Account already exists
firebase-auth-account-exists-with-differ.body: This email signed in with another provider. Use that one to avoid duplicates.

firebase-auth-invalid-credential.title: Invalid credential
firebase-auth-invalid-credential.body: Google rejected the token. Usually means the session expired mid-flow.

firebase-auth-too-many-requests.title: Too many sign-in attempts
firebase-auth-too-many-requests.body: Google locked it for a few minutes. Breathe, come back later.

provider-401.title: Invalid API key
provider-401.body: The provider doesn't recognize this key. Paste it whole, no spaces.

provider-429.title: Provider rate limit hit
provider-429.body: You sent too fast. Wait the cooldown or switch modes.

provider-5xx.title: Provider is down
provider-5xx.body: Not you. The model is flaky. The queue will retry on its own.

provider-timeout.title: Response timed out
provider-timeout.body: Over 30s with no reply. Usually a long context — trim or retry.

provider-context-exceeded.title: Conversation is too long
provider-context-exceeded.body: The model can't fit this thread anymore. Start a new one to keep going.

provider-content-filter.title: Blocked by content filter
provider-content-filter.body: The provider refused the content. Rewrite or switch model.

tauri-command-failed.title: System command failed
tauri-command-failed.body: Hat sent something to the OS that didn't come back. Restart usually fixes.

tauri-capability-denied.title: Capability denied
tauri-capability-denied.body: This action isn't in capabilities.json. The OS blocks it without that.

tauri-fs-error.title: Filesystem error
tauri-fs-error.body: Hat tried to read or write and got denied. Permission or disk full.

clipboard-read-failed.title: Can't read clipboard
clipboard-read-failed.body: The OS didn't release it this time. Copy again and hit the shortcut.

credits-insufficient.title: You're out of credits
credits-insufficient.body: Top up via PIX in seconds — stay in flow without leaving Hat.
